name: teachme-showme
description: Skills that turn a request into one self-contained HTML file: TeachMe builds a complete course you study from, ShowMe builds a deck you present from.

plugins.name: teachme
plugins.description: Teach any subject end to end as one self-contained HTML course — prerequisites, mechanisms, worked examples, diagrams, exercises and checkpoint quizzes, with progress tracking, search and offline reading. Use when someone wants to genuinely learn something rather than get an answer, when a chat reply would be too short or skip prerequisites, or when turning slides, documents or a codebase into study material.

plugins.name: showme
plugins.description: Build a presentation as one self-contained HTML deck — fullscreen slides, progressive builds, speaker notes with a timer, overview grid, read mode and print-to-PDF, in a theme chosen to match the look you describe. Use whenever someone has to present to an audience, or wants a document, report or project turned into slides.
